name: SSME staged combustion at rated power level (public NASA data)
description: LOX/LH2 fuel-rich staged combustion with two preburners and four turbopumps, built only from public NASA documents: station pressures, speeds, powers, flows and turbine inlet temperatures from the 1981 Space Shuttle News Reference (rated power level), preburner flow split from the heat-balance column of NASA TP-3700 Table A.6, chamber c* from the shipped CEA tables. Turbine efficiencies, line volumes and the start sequence are estimates.

known_limitations: Station data mix two public sources: the 1981 News Reference engine (rated power, 2970 psia) and the NASA TP-3700 heat balance (3006 psia) for the preburner split; the 104.5 % power level flown later has no complete public station set.
The low-pressure oxidizer turbine is a liquid-oxygen hydraulic turbine; the catalog has only a gas turbine, so its pressure ratio and efficiency are carried but its gas equations do not apply.
The nozzle coolant tubes take heat from the chamber wall port; the catalog has no nozzle wall port.
Chamber coolant valve, pogo accumulator, tank pressurization taps, igniters and purges are not modelled.
Turbine efficiencies are estimates; with them the turbine exits sit at 3232 psia (HPFT) and 3362 psia (HPOT) against 2970 psia in the chamber.
Regenerative channel geometry and shaft inertias are not in a public NASA source and are left null.
